description: This file implements the WebRTC command channel classes for sending and receiving WebRTC commands and responses over a file descriptor, including serialization and deserialization of protocol buffer messages.

classes.name: WebrtcClientCommandChannel
classes.description: Handles sending WebRTC command requests and receiving responses over a file descriptor.

classes.name: WebrtcServerCommandChannel
classes.description: Handles receiving WebRTC command requests and sending responses over a file descriptor.

methods.name: ToMessage
methods.description: Serializes a protocol buffer message into a transport message.

methods.name: ToProto
methods.description: Deserializes a transport message into a protocol buffer message.

methods.name: WebrtcClientCommandChannel::SendCommand
methods.description: Sends a WebRTC command request and waits for a response.
